d: We are currently looking for a dynamic, passionate, and self-motivated Food & Beverage professional who is eager to grow their career in hospitality.

As a Barista, you will be the face of our coffee service, creating memorable moments for every guest through warm hospitality and expertly crafted beverages. You will prepare and serve high-quality coffee, specialty drinks, teas, and other beverages in a welcoming and efficient manner, while maintaining the highest standards of quality, cleanliness, safety, and presentation.
Through every interaction, you will contribute to an exceptional guest experience and help us create “Treasured Time” for our guests.
q: You should ideally have a diploma in Hospitality Management or relevant vocational training in Food & Beverage, with previous experience as a Barista, preferably within a high-volume restaurant, café, or hotel environment.

A good command of English is essential, along with strong guest service, communication, and interpersonal skills. Knowledge of coffee preparation techniques, beverage presentation, and basic food hygiene standards will be an advantage.
The ideal candidate will be a hands-on, energetic, and service-oriented professional with a genuine passion for coffee, hospitality, and creating memorable guest experiences.

You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, remain calm and positive under pressure, and demonstrate strong attention to detail while maintaining consistent service and product quality.
You should possess the following key competencies
r: li
Welcome guests warmly and provide friendly, attentive, and personalized service.
li
Understand guest preferences and confidently recommend menu items, including appropriate upselling opportunities.
li
Prepare and serve coffee, espresso-based drinks, teas, and other beverages according to established recipes and quality standards.
li
Ensure consistency in taste, presentation, quality, and speed of service .
li
Handle guest requests, feedback, and concerns professionally and promptly, escalating matters when required.
li
Monitor stock levels of coffee, milk, beverages, and other supplies, and communicate replenishment requirements in a timely manner.
li
Maintain a clean, organized, and well-presented workstation throughout the shift.
li
Follow all food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and workplace safety standards.
li
Regularly clean and sanitize coffee machines, equipment, utensils, counters, and service areas.
li
Work closely with colleagues to ensure smooth and efficient service, particularly during busy periods.
li
Participate in team briefings, meetings, and training sessions to remain updated on menu offerings and service standards.
li
Support fellow team members and contribute to a positive, collaborative, and energetic working environment .
li
Accurately process cash, card, and other payments through the Point of Sale (POS) system .
li
Ensure accurate billing, receipt issuance, and proper balancing of the cash register at the end of each shift.

d: The LSU Service Sales Manager is responsible for defining, leading, and executing the Services Sales strategy in Saudi Arabia. This role leads and develops the Country Services Sales team, driving profitable growth across the entire service lifecycle. This position ensures strong alignment with Hitachi Energy’s global and Hub service strategies while effectively addressing local market needs evolving market trends. A key focus is to maximize installed base (IB) penetration, generate and grow sustainable service revenues, and strengthen long-term customer relationships.
q: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in electrical power, energy, and industry.
Minimum 15 years of leadership experience in Service Sales for High Voltage equipment and Power Transformers, serving electric utilities, transmission operators, and power sector customers.
Proven Service Sales leadership experience in an OEM environment with large installed base management.
Demonstrated experience leading, coaching, and developing Service Sales & Marketing teams to achieve growth targets.
Experience managing multi-product and multi-service portfolios across the service lifecycle.
Experience within the Saudi Arabian market, including utilities, industry, and infrastructure projects.
Knowledge of Saudi localization, contracting, and regulatory requirements.
Solid understanding of Hitachi Energy products and systems (or equivalent).
Proficiency in both spoken & written in English & Arabic language is required.

d: Lean is looking for a hands-on Software Engineering Manager to lead and grow our Client Experience (CX) engineering team. This is a player-coach role: you'll be writing and reviewing production code, setting architectural direction, and leading a team — often in the same week. You'll own the platform components, APIs, and standards that define the quality of every client integration, and partner closely with Product to ship meaningful improvements to client activation and experience. This is a rare opportunity to build a team from the ground up into a genuine pillar of Lean's engineering organisation.

Lean is the leading financial infrastructure provider in the Middle East. We power some of the region's largest companies with APIs that enable payments, account verification, financial data access, and other critical financial infrastructure.

What started as the region's pioneering Open Banking platform and quickly became the de facto leader in account aggregation and payment initiation in the region is now becoming something bigger: a multi-product infrastructure company powering payments, data, and lending across MENA.

We've processed billions of dollars in transactions. We're trusted by 350+ clients — from Binance and Careem to Etisalat — and backed by General Catalyst, Sequoia, and Shorooq. Our $67.5M Series B was just the beginning. We're expanding into new markets, opening offices, acquiring businesses, and building capabilities that didn't exist here before.
q: 8+ years of engineering experience, with 3+ years in a management or equivalent role demonstrating both technical and people leadership
Full-stack engineering capability — comfortable writing and reviewing production code across frontend and backend, with AI-assisted development as a standard part of how you work
Strong proficiency with React, TypeScript, Java, and Spring Boot
Experience in backend systems design and architecture
Deep familiarity with API design principles and best practices
A quality-first mindset — testing frameworks are visible in your work history and you have a clear, practised approach to how quality gets delivered
Ability to manage observability, monitoring, and incident response for production services
Track record of building and growing engineering teams through hiring and internal development
Strong communicator — able to translate technical decisions for non-technical audiences and vice versa
Comfortable operating in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments and making good decisions with incomplete information
Experience in fintech or regulated industries
Prior experience scaling a team from a small group to 5+ direct reports

NB. While we think the above experience could be important, we’re keen to hear from people that believe they have valuable experience to bring to the role. If you identify with the team and mission, but not all of our requirements, then please still apply!!
r: li

CX delivery — lead project management and technical execution for the CX squad as a true player-coach: writing and reviewing production code, making architectural decisions, and driving technical strategy, all in one role
li
Platform ownership — maintain and evolve CX-owned platform components, ensuring reliability, quality, and continuous improvement of the services that underpin the client experience
li

API standards — act as the authoritative standards-setter for Lean's APIs across all products; provide tooling and guidance to other engineering teams to drive adoption of consistent, high-quality API design
li
People leadership — manage, coach, and develop a team of 2 engineers today, with a clear mandate to grow the team to 5–8 reports through 2027
li
Team building — make the case for headcount growth, hire great engineers, and build CX into a standalone pillar with an ambitious mission spanning all client touchpoints
x: We’re building the financial infrastructure for MENA. Not as a slogan, as a fact.

Since 2019, we’ve become the first regulated Open Banking and Open Finance company operating across the UAE and Saudi Arabia. We’ve processed billions of dollars. We connect millions of accounts. We enable companies like Binance, Careem, and Etisalat to build products that were previously impossible in this region.

Our recent $67.5M Series B from General Catalyst and Sequoia isn’t just validation: it’s fuel. We’re expanding into new markets, launching new products, and setting the pace for what financial innovation looks like in MENA.
We solve hard problems. We move fast. We hold ourselves to a high standard. And we’re looking for people who’ve done this before to help us do it right.
If you’re motivated by building something that lasts, not just something that scales, Lean is where you need to be.

Not only do we offer competitive salaries, private healthcare, and flexible office hours, but we also insist that every member of the team hold a meaningful equity stake in the business to ensure long-term alignment. We'd love you to join us for this journey!

Lean is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.
